source.source: HYG v4.4 (Hipparcos-Yale-Gliese Database, D. Nash / astronexus)
source.epoch: ICRS/J2000 equinox; source astrometry primarily Hipparcos-2007 reduction, epoch J1991.25
source.sentinelDistDoc: dist == 100000.0 marks an unmeasurable/negative Hipparcos parallax; rows with it are dropped, not shipped.
source.hipSentinelDoc: hip == 0 means the row has no Hipparcos catalogue number.

galacticFrame.source: Hipparcos Catalogue vol. 1 §1.5.3 (ESA SP-1200, 1997); J2000 galactic frame constants shared by astropy and SOFA

panorama.title: The Milky Way panorama
panorama.longitudeConvention: l = 0 at the column centre, increasing leftward (sky seen from inside)
panorama.latitudeConvention: b = +90 at row 0, -90 at the last row

catalogRegistration.role: retained source record only; the photograph is registered astrometrically and owns visible stars

pointSourcePresentation.positionSource: licensed ESO photographic local maxima; no Google catalogue bytes
pointSourcePresentation.qualification: native fixed-size catalogue behavior collapsed into the prepared cubemap; point positions and colors remain ESO-derived

sky.qualification: source-photographed full sky sampled in ICRF through the J2000 galactic frame and the anchor-registered panorama; the scene registration carries the Charon pole and epoch; Solar System objects in the mosaic are capture artefacts; no Sun is baked into the cubemap
sky.sceneRegistrationChain: galactic -> ICRF (J2000 constants) -> body-fixed (IAU pole and prime meridian at the epoch) -> ecliptic presentation frame

analyticRadialFit.qualification: Least-squares fit to annular red-channel means from the bound native 128 by 128 Sun texture; fitted values only, no source pixels.

distanceScaling.qualification: The opaque photospheric core is projected from the IAU nominal solar radius and the object catalog's mean heliocentric distance. The retained glow profile remains a visual presentation; the distance is not epoch-specific.

provenance.source: JPL Horizons Charon relative-orbit fit and Pluto heliocentric elements; NAIF pck00011 orientation
provenance.qualification: Computed Charon Sun direction at 2026-09-03T00:00:00 TT, expressed in the ecliptic presentation frame (north up, Sun left at zero yaw) and in view space at the default camera pose.

controls.label: Monochrome
controls.description: New Horizons observed terrain; southern darkness remains unavailable. Native detail varies across the map. The source already applies Lunar-Lambert photometric correction; local photographed terrain shadows remain.
controls.summary: Lighting is corrected, but local photographed shadows remain. Detail varies; the unobserved south is left unavailable.
controls.title: Monochrome mosaic

controls.label: Enhanced color
controls.description: Enhanced color combines MVIC near-infrared, red and blue bands, sharpened with panchromatic detail. It is not natural color or quantitative albedo. Gray grid marks missing color coverage; detail varies across the map.
controls.title: MVIC enhanced-color mosaic

controls.label: Elevation
controls.description: Measured topography relative to a 606 km sphere. Gray grid marks missing elevation. Stereo/shape-from-shading product; 300 m grid spacing is not uniform effective resolution.
controls.summary: Stereo and shading height relative to a 606 km sphere. Detail varies; the gray grid marks missing data.
controls.title: Stereo and shading terrain model

controls.label: Bond albedo
controls.description: New Horizons photometric model estimating the fraction of sunlight reflected by Charon. Derived from LORRI brightness and scattering assumptions, not a direct bolometric measurement. Gray grid marks missing source cells and uncovered southern latitudes. Colors span 0.1–0.5; values beyond those limits use endpoint colors.
controls.title: New Horizons modeled Bond albedo
